title: Pump not reachable. Watchdog sleeping
symptom: AAPS loses connection to the pump and Watchdog cannot fix it, possibly because it is shown as connected in the Omnipod tab. The user has to toggle Bluetooth multiple times a day.
cause: The watchdog's Bluetooth toggle duration of 1 second is too short to fix the issue.
fix: Increase the sleep and Bluetooth disable/enable durations in QueueThread.kt from 1000 to 10000 milliseconds.
evidence_quote: I had a look in the code and realised that 1 second is too short a time frame for the watchdog bark. so increased this to 10s for all three steps.
